name: train_2_results
title: Train it after a training run: tiles, tabs and the comparison table

items.label: Held-out power RMSE
items.text: Held-out power error (RMSE) in kilowatts on trips the model never saw. Lower is better.

items.label: Trip-energy error
items.text: The typical error of the total energy of a whole trip (median of the absolute errors).

items.label: Paper, same setting
items.text: What the paper got with the same model, target and data amount.

items.label: Computed on your device
items.text: How long the training took on your computer.

items.label: Result tabs
items.text: Importance: which inputs mattered. Learning curve: error against data amount, with the paper's curve. Table: your run beside the paper. Runs: every run of this visit. MATLAB: MATLAB's own fit of the same models, when it exists.

items.label: Export runs as CSV
items.text: Export runs as CSV saves the runs of this visit as a file. Runs are not stored anywhere else and are lost when you close the page.

items.label: Table
items.text: The table sets your run against the paper's stored result for the same setting. LightGBM on all the data should land almost exactly on the paper's number.
